import json

ids=sorted(r['id'] for r in rows if 'note' in r and r['note'] is None)
open('scratch/null-notes.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(ids,ensure_ascii=False))
print(ids)
" && cat scratch/null-notes.json && echo && md5sum scratch/rows.json
